en.t: Following the death of Edward the Confessor on the previous day, the Witan meets to confirm Harold Godwinson as the new King of England; Harold is crowned the same day, sparking a succession crisis that will eventually lead to the Norman conquest of England
en.s: Harold Godwinson (c. 1022/23 – 14 October 1066), also called Harold II, was the last crowned Anglo-Saxon king of England. Harold reigned from 6 January 1066 until his death at the Battle of Hastings on 14 October 1066, the decisive battle of the Norman Conquest. He was succeeded by William the Conqueror, the victor at Hastings.

zh.t: 忏悔者爱德华去世翌日，贤人会议确认哈罗德·戈德温森为英格兰国王；他当天加冕，引发王位继承危机，最终导致诺曼征服英格兰
zh.s: 哈罗德·戈德温森（约1022或1023年—1066年10月14日），又称哈罗德二世，是最后一位加冕的盎格鲁-撒克逊英格兰国王。他从1066年1月6日起在位，直到同年10月14日在诺曼征服的决定性战役黑斯廷斯战役中阵亡。黑斯廷斯的胜利者征服者威廉随后继承王位。

en.s: The Battle of Mount Cadmus took place near Laodicea at Chonae on 6 January 1148 during the Second Crusade. The French Crusader army, led by Louis VII of France, was defeated by the Seljuks of Rum.

zh.s: 卡德穆斯山战役发生于第二次十字军东征期间的1148年1月6日，战场位于霍奈一带、老底嘉附近。法国国王路易七世率领的法国十字军被罗姆塞尔柱军队击败。

en.t: Philip of Swabia undergoes a second coronation as King of the Romans
en.s: Philip of Swabia (German: Philipp von Schwaben; February/March 1177 – 21 June 1208), styled Philip II in his charters, was a member of the House of Hohenstaufen and King of Germany from 1198 until his assassination. The death of Philip's older brother Henry VI, Holy Roman Emperor, in 1197 meant that the Hohenstaufen rule (which reached as far as the Kingdom of Sicily) collapsed in imperial Italy and created a power vacuum to the north of the Alps.

zh.t: 施瓦本的菲利普第二次加冕为罗马人的国王
zh.s: 施瓦本的菲利普（德语：Philipp von Schwaben，1177年2月或3月—1208年6月21日）在文书中自称菲利普二世，是霍亨斯陶芬家族成员，自1198年起担任德意志国王，直至遭暗杀。其兄、神圣罗马皇帝亨利六世于1197年去世后，霍亨斯陶芬家族在帝国属意大利地区的统治崩溃。其势力此前远及西西里王国，亨利之死也在阿尔卑斯山以北造成权力真空。

en.t: Stefan Uroš III is crowned King of Serbia and his son is crowned young king
en.s: Nicodemus, the archbishop of Serbia, crowned Stefan Dečanski (Stefan Uroš III) king on 6 January 1322. His son Stefan Dušan was crowned young king in the same ceremony.
en.n: This entry records the coronation. It does not assign Konstantin’s later defeat in the succession struggle to this date.

zh.t: 斯特凡·乌罗什三世加冕为塞尔维亚国王，其子同场加冕为“年轻国王”
zh.s: 1322年1月6日，塞尔维亚大主教尼科迪姆为斯特凡·德查尼（斯特凡·乌罗什三世）加冕为国王。他的儿子斯特凡·杜尚在同一场仪式中被加冕为“年轻国王”。
zh.n: 此条记录的是加冕仪式，不将王位争夺中康斯坦丁后来战败的事件归于这一天。

en.t: Charles IV of Bohemia is crowned with the Iron Crown of Lombardy as King of Italy in Milan
en.s: The Iron Crown (in Italian, Latin, and Lombard: Corona Ferrea; German: Eiserne Krone) is a reliquary votive crown, traditionally considered one of the oldest royal insignia of Christendom. It was made in the Middle Ages, consisting of a circlet of gold and jewels fitted around a central silver band, which tradition held to be made of iron beaten out of a nail of the True Cross.

zh.t: 波希米亚国王查理四世在米兰以伦巴第铁王冠加冕为意大利国王
zh.s: 铁王冠（意大利语、拉丁语及伦巴第语：Corona Ferrea；德语：Eiserne Krone）是一顶兼具圣物匣与奉献用途的王冠，传统上被视为基督教世界最古老的王权标志之一。它制作于中世纪，由金饰和宝石组成的冠环围绕中央银带构成。传统认为，这条带子是用真十字架上的一枚铁钉锤打而成。

en.s: The Battle of Nebovidy was fought on January 6, 1422 between the Holy Roman Empire and the Hussites. The Hussites were led by Jan Žižka, while the Imperial forces were led by Emperor Sigismund. The Hussites were victorious.

zh.s: 1422年1月6日，神圣罗马帝国军队与胡斯派在内博维迪交战。扬·杰士卡率领胡斯派，皇帝西吉斯蒙德率领帝国军队，最终胡斯派获胜。

en.t: Constantine XI is proclaimed Byzantine Emperor at Mystras
en.s: Constantine XI Dragases Palaiologos or Dragaš Palaeologus (Greek: Κωνσταντῖνος Δραγάσης Παλαιολόγος, romanized: Kōnstantīnos Dragásēs Palaiológos; 8 February 1404 – 29 May 1453) was the last reigning Byzantine emperor. He died in battle at the fall of Constantinople on 29 May 1453. Constantine's death marked the definitive end of the Eastern Roman Empire, which traced its origin to Constantine the Great's foundation of Constantinople as the Roman Empire's new capital in 330.
en.n: This entry records the civil proclamation at Mystras on January 6, not a traditional coronation in Constantinople.

zh.t: 君士坦丁十一世在米斯特拉斯被宣布为拜占庭皇帝
zh.s: 君士坦丁十一世·德拉加塞斯·巴列奥略（希腊语：Κωνσταντῖνος Δραγάσης Παλαιολόγος，1404年2月8日—1453年5月29日）是拜占庭帝国最后一位在位皇帝。1453年5月29日君士坦丁堡陷落时，他在战斗中身亡。他的死亡标志着东罗马帝国的最终终结；这一帝国的历史渊源可追溯至330年君士坦丁大帝将君士坦丁堡建为罗马帝国新首都。
zh.n: 此条记录的是1月6日在米斯特拉斯举行的世俗宣布仪式，而不是在君士坦丁堡举行的传统加冕仪式。

en.t: The Catholic Monarchs Ferdinand and Isabella enter Granada at the conclusion of the Granada War
en.s: The Catholic Monarchs were Queen Isabella I of Castile (r. 1474–1504) and King Ferdinand II of Aragon (r. 1479–1516), whose marriage and joint rule marked the de facto unification of Spain. They were both from the House of Trastámara and were second cousins, as they were both descended from John I of Castile.

zh.t: 格拉纳达战争结束后，天主教双王斐迪南与伊莎贝拉进入格拉纳达
zh.s: “天主教双王”指卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝拉一世（1474—1504年在位）和阿拉贡国王斐迪南二世（1479—1516年在位）。两人的婚姻及共同统治标志着西班牙在事实上走向统一。他们同属特拉斯塔马拉王朝，都是卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安一世的后裔，因此互为再从兄妹。

en.s: The naval Battle of Calicut (known then and now as Kozhikode) was a military encounter between the 16 ships (10 carracks and six caravels) of the 4th Portuguese Armada and a fleet led by two Arabic corsairs formed under the orders of the Zamorin of Kozhikode. After the fleet of Vasco da Gama reunited with 6 caravels of the patrol fleet of Vicente Sodré, the Portuguese inflicted a heavy defeat on Kozhikode.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡利卡特海战发生在今天称为科泽科德的地区。葡萄牙第四支印度远征舰队的16艘船（10艘卡拉克帆船和6艘卡拉维尔帆船），与奉科泽科德萨莫林之命组建、由两名阿拉伯私掠船长率领的舰队交战。瓦斯科·达·伽马的舰队与维森特·索德雷巡逻舰队的6艘卡拉维尔帆船会合后，葡军重创科泽科德方面。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The first European school of higher learning in the Americas, Colegio de Santa Cruz de Tlatelolco, is founded by Viceroy Antonio de Mendoza and Bishop Juan de Zumárraga in Mexico City
en.s: The Colegio de Santa Cruz in Tlatelolco, Mexico City, is the first and oldest European school of higher learning in the Americas and the first major school of interpreters and translators in the New World. It was established by the Franciscans on January 6, 1536, with the intention, as is generally accepted, of preparing Native American boys for eventual ordination to the Catholic priesthood.

zh.t: 总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨与主教胡安·德·苏马拉加在墨西哥城创立特拉特洛尔科圣十字学院，美洲首所欧式高等学府
zh.s: 位于墨西哥城特拉特洛尔科的圣十字学院，是美洲第一所、也是最古老的欧式高等学府，还是新世界首所重要的口笔译人才学校。学院由方济各会于1536年1月6日创办。普遍认为，其目的是培养美洲原住民男孩，为他们日后受任天主教神父作准备。

en.t: King Henry VIII of England married his fourth wife, Anne of Cleves; the marriage was annulled six months later
en.s: Anne of Cleves (German: Anna von Kleve; 28 June or 22 September 1515 – 16 July 1557) was a German princess who briefly became Queen of England in 1540 as the fourth wife of Henry VIII, from their marriage on 6 January until its annulment on 12 July. Born in Düsseldorf to John III, Duke of Cleves and Maria of Jülich-Berg, little is known about Anne before 1527.

zh.t: 英格兰国王亨利八世迎娶第四任妻子克里维斯的安妮，婚姻六个月后被宣布无效
zh.s: 克里维斯的安妮（德语：Anna von Kleve，1515年6月28日或9月22日—1557年7月16日）是德意志公主，1540年作为亨利八世的第四任妻子短暂担任英格兰王后，从1月6日结婚至7月12日婚姻被宣布无效。她出生于杜塞尔多夫，父母为克里维斯公爵约翰三世及于利希-贝格的玛丽亚。人们对她1527年之前的经历所知不多。

en.s: On 6 January 1585, Walter Raleigh was knighted under Queen Elizabeth I of England.
en.n: The knighthood is dated 6 January 1585 in the cited scholarly study.

zh.s: 1585年1月6日，沃尔特·雷利在英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世统治期间获封爵士。
zh.n: 据所引学术研究，雷利获封爵士的日期为1585年1月6日。

en.s: The Battle of Hitotoribashi (Japanese: 人取橋の戦い) was a battle during the Azuchi-Momoyama period (16th century) of Japan. Due to the death of Date Masamune's father, Date Terumune by the hands of Nihonmatsu Yoshitsugu, Masamune swore vengeance. After succeeding to the throne of the Date clan, Masamune would effectively have his revenge by launching an attack against the Nihonmatsu clan and their allies at Hitotoribashi in January 1586.

zh.s: 人取桥之战（日语：人取橋の戦い）是日本16世纪安土桃山时代的一场战斗。伊达政宗的父亲伊达辉宗死于二本松义继之手，政宗为此誓言复仇。政宗继承伊达家家督之位后，于1586年1月在人取桥进攻二本松氏及其盟友，以报父仇。

en.s: The siege of Tomioka Castle (2–6 January 1638) was a defeat of the rebel peasants and ronin during Shimabara Rebellion. After a successful uprising in Shimabara Domain, several thousand of rebels crossed the sea to the nearby Amakusa islands, domain of the Terazawa family, to help the local Christians who rose to arms at the same time.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 富冈城围城战发生于1638年1月2日至6日，是岛原之乱期间起义农民与浪人遭遇的一次失败。岛原藩起义取得成功后，数千名起义者渡海前往附近由寺泽氏统治的天草群岛，支援同时举兵的当地基督徒。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Committee of Inquiry on the South Sea Bubble publishes its findings, revealing details of fraud among company directors and corrupt politicians
en.s: The South Sea Company was a British joint-stock company founded in January 1711, created as a public-private partnership to consolidate and reduce the cost of the national debt. To generate income, in 1713 the company was granted a monopoly (the Asiento de Negros) to supply enslaved Africans to the islands in the "South Seas" and South America.

zh.t: 南海泡沫调查委员会公布调查结果，揭露公司董事欺诈与政客腐败细节
zh.s: 南海公司是一家于1711年1月成立的英国股份公司，以公私合作方式整合国债、降低偿债成本。为创造收入，公司于1713年获授黑奴贸易特许权（Asiento de Negros），垄断向“南海”诸岛及南美洲贩运非洲奴隶的业务。

en.t: Sie werden aus Saba alle kommen, BWV 65, a Bach cantata, for Epiphany, is performed the first time
en.s: Sie werden aus Saba alle kommen (They will all come forth out of Sheba), BWV 65, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. He composed it in 1724 in Leipzig for Epiphany and first performed it on 6 January 1724 as part of his first cantata cycle. Bach wrote the cantata to conclude his first Christmas season as Thomaskantor in Leipzig which had been celebrated with five cantatas, four of them new compositions, the Magnificat and a new Sanctus.

zh.t: 巴赫为主显节创作的康塔塔《他们都将从示巴前来》（BWV 65）首次演出
zh.s: 《他们都将从示巴前来》（Sie werden aus Saba alle kommen，BWV 65）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫的教会康塔塔。他于1724年在莱比锡为主显节创作此曲，并于同年1月6日首次演出，属于他的第一套康塔塔年作。这首作品为巴赫担任莱比锡圣托马斯教堂乐长后的首个圣诞节期收尾；该节期共演出了五首康塔塔，其中四首为新作，另有《尊主颂》及一首新创作的《圣哉经》。

en.t: J. S. Bach led the first performance of Liebster Immanuel, Herzog der Frommen, a chorale cantata for Epiphany
en.s: Liebster Immanuel, Herzog der Frommen (Dearest Immanuel, Lord of the Faithful), BWV 123, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. He composed it in Leipzig for Epiphany and first performed it on 6 January 1725. It is based on the 1679 hymn of the same name by Ahasverus Fritsch which is focused on the contrast of the vanities of the world and the trust in support by Jesus.

zh.t: 巴赫指挥主显节众赞歌康塔塔《亲爱的以马内利，虔信者之主》首演
zh.s: 《亲爱的以马内利，虔信者之主》（Liebster Immanuel, Herzog der Frommen，BWV 123）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫创作的教会康塔塔。他在莱比锡为主显节创作此曲，于1725年1月6日首次演出。作品以阿哈斯韦鲁斯·弗里奇1679年的同名赞美诗为基础，对比世俗的虚荣与对耶稣扶助的信赖。

en.s: The Battle of Jersey (6 January 1781) was an attempt by French forces to invade Jersey and remove the threat the island posed to French and American shipping in the Anglo-French War. Jersey provided a base for British privateers, and France, engaged in the war as an ally of the United States, sent an expedition to gain control of the island. The French expedition ultimately failed. Its commander, Baron Phillipe de Rullecourt, died of wounds sustained in the fighting. The battle is often remembered for the death of the British officer Major Peirson, and a painting based on his final moments by John Singleton Copley.

zh.s: 1781年1月6日，法军试图入侵泽西岛，消除该岛在英法战争中对法国和美国航运的威胁。泽西岛是英国私掠船的基地，法国作为美国盟友参战，因此派出远征军夺岛，但最终失败。法军指挥官菲利普·德·吕勒库尔男爵因战斗负伤而死。英军皮尔森少校也在此役阵亡；约翰·辛格尔顿·科普利以他生命最后一刻为题作画，使这场战役广为后人记忆。

en.t: 1797 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1797 United States Senate election in Delaware was held on January 6, 1797. Henry Latimer defeated the future governor of Delaware David Hall by 10 votes.

zh.t: 1797年美国特拉华州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1797年1月6日，特拉华州举行联邦参议员选举。亨利·拉蒂默以10票优势击败后来成为特拉华州州长的戴维·霍尔。

en.s: The Portuguese conquest of French Guiana, also known as Conquest of Cayenne (Portuguese: Conquista de Caiena), was the capture of the French colony of Cayenne by Anglo-Portuguese forces in January 1809 during the Napoleonic Wars. It formed part of the Caribbean campaign of 1803–1810, a British-led campaign against the colonies of France and its allies during the conflict.

zh.t: 葡萄牙征服法属圭亚那
zh.s: 葡萄牙征服法属圭亚那又称征服卡宴（葡萄牙语：Conquista de Caiena），是拿破仑战争期间，英葡联军于1809年1月攻占法国卡宴殖民地的行动。它属于1803年至1810年加勒比战役的一部分；这场战役由英国主导，针对法国及其盟友的殖民地展开。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1834 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on January 6, 1834, in order to elect the governor of Maryland. Incumbent National Republican governor James Thomas was re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly against Democratic nominee and former governor Edward Lloyd.

zh.s: 1834年1月6日，马里兰州举行州长选举。国家共和党籍现任州长詹姆斯·托马斯经州议会选举获得连任，击败民主党候选人、前州长爱德华·劳埃德。

en.t: Alfred Vail and colleagues demonstrate a telegraph system using dots and dashes (this is the forerunner of Morse code)
en.s: Alfred Lewis Vail (September 25, 1807 – January 18, 1859) was an American machinist and inventor. Along with Samuel Morse, Vail was central in developing and commercializing American electrical telegraphy between 1837 and 1844.

zh.t: 阿尔弗雷德·韦尔与同事演示使用点划信号的电报系统，成为摩尔斯电码的先驱
zh.s: 阿尔弗雷德·刘易斯·韦尔（1807年9月25日—1859年1月18日）是美国机械师和发明家。1837年至1844年间，他与塞缪尔·摩尔斯在美国电报技术的开发与商业化中发挥了核心作用。

en.s: The Battle of Buin was fought on January 6, 1839, during the Chilean second expedition of the War of the Confederation. The Restoring Army rearguard led by General Manuel Bulnes successfully held the bridge over the Buin River in the North Peruvian territory from the attack of the Confederacy Army commanded by Marshal Andres de Santa Cruz, yet retreated to San Miguel leaving the field before Santa Cruz could engage him again. Both countries consider this action as a victory. In Chile, a regiment was named "Buin" 1st Line Regiment on 1851, in commemoration of the soldiers who fought and died in this encounter.

zh.s: 1839年1月6日，智利在邦联战争中第二次出征期间，爆发布因战役。曼努埃尔·布尔内斯将军率领复国军后卫，在北秘鲁境内成功守住布因河桥，抵挡安德烈斯·德·圣克鲁斯元帅率领的邦联军进攻。但在圣克鲁斯再次发起交战前，布尔内斯已撤向圣米格尔，离开战场。两国都将此战视为胜利。1851年，智利把一支部队命名为“布因”第一线列团，以纪念在此役中战斗和牺牲的士兵。

en.t: The Night of the Big Wind begins across Ireland
en.s: A powerful windstorm began sweeping across Ireland on January 6, bringing destructive winds that continued into the following night. The storm damaged or destroyed homes, wrecked ships and killed hundreds of people across Ireland and parts of Britain. In northern Dublin, an estimated fifth to a quarter of houses sustained damage. Contemporary accounts also describe severe losses at sea, where many ships could not reach shelter. The event became a lasting part of Irish memory as the Night of the Big Wind. Its exact onset, geographic reach and reported toll distinguish it from an ordinary winter storm.

zh.s: 1月6日，一场强烈风暴开始横扫爱尔兰，破坏性大风持续到次日夜间。风暴损坏或摧毁房屋，造成船只沉没，爱尔兰及英国部分地区有数百人死亡。估计都柏林北部五分之一至四分之一的房屋受损。当时的记载还描述了严重的海上损失，许多船只来不及驶入避风港。这场灾难以“大风之夜”留在爱尔兰人的集体记忆中。其具体发生时间、影响范围及记载的伤亡规模，使它有别于普通的冬季风暴。

en.s: The Battle of Hancock was fought during the Confederate Romney Expedition of the American Civil War on January 5 and 6, 1862, near Hancock, Maryland. Major General Stonewall Jackson of the Confederate States Army, commanding his own Valley District and Brigadier General William W. Loring's force known as the Confederate Army of the Northwest, began moving against Union Army forces in the Shenandoah Valley area on January 1.

zh.s: 汉考克战役发生于美国内战期间邦联军的罗姆尼远征中，时间为1862年1月5日至6日，地点在马里兰州汉考克附近。1月1日，邦联军少将“石墙”杰克逊率自己指挥的谷地区部队，以及威廉·W. 洛林准将率领、称为邦联西北军的部队，开始向谢南多厄河谷一带的联邦军进军。

en.s: The Capture of the Amambaí steam occurred on January 6, 1865, when the Paraguayan corvettes Yporá and Río Apa attacked the Amambaí gunboat on São Lourenço River, after the people who had been evacuated from the Fort of Coimbra and Corumbá landed in Sará. Yporá rammed the gunboat Amambaí, throwing it against the bank, near Morro do Caracará.

zh.s: 1865年1月6日，巴拉圭轻型护卫舰“伊波拉”号与“阿帕河”号在圣洛伦索河袭击“阿曼巴伊”号炮舰，将其俘获。此前，从科英布拉要塞和科伦巴撤离的人员已在萨拉下船。“伊波拉”号撞击“阿曼巴伊”号，将其推向卡拉卡拉山附近的河岸。

en.s: The siege of Rocroi took place from 4 to 6 January 1871 during the Franco-Prussian War. Rocroi was a French stronghold west of Sedan. Prussian artillery bombardment forced the French garrison to surrender.

en.s: The siege of Lydenburg was a siege carried out by South African Republican forces on British-occupied Lydenburg, between January and March 1881 during the First Boer War. Despite fierce British resistance, the Boers reclaimed the town following the British defeat at the end of the war. The siege lasted 84 days.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莱登堡围城战发生于第一次布尔战争期间的1881年1月至3月，由南非共和国军队围攻英国占领的莱登堡。尽管英军顽强抵抗，布尔人仍在战争结束、英国战败后收复该镇。围城持续了84天。

en.s: The Otaki by-election of 1900 was a by-election during the 14th New Zealand Parliament. The election was held on 6 January following the death of Henry Augustus Field, and was won by his brother William Hughes Field.

en.t: Second Boer War: Having already besieged the fortress at Ladysmith, Boer forces attack it, but are driven back by British defenders
en.s: The Second Boer War was a conflict fought between 1899 and 1902 between the British Empire and the Boer republics (the South African Republic and Orange Free State) over Britain's influence in Southern Africa. The Witwatersrand Gold Rush caused an influx of "foreigners" (Uitlanders), most of them British from the Cape Colony, to the South African Republic (SAR), an independent Boer Republic.

zh.t: 第二次布尔战争：已包围莱迪史密斯要塞的布尔军发动进攻，被英军守军击退
zh.s: 第二次布尔战争于1899年至1902年间，在大英帝国与布尔人共和国（南非共和国及奥兰治自由邦）之间进行，争端涉及英国在非洲南部的影响力。威特沃特斯兰德淘金热使大量“外来者”（Uitlanders）涌入独立的布尔人国家南非共和国（SAR），其中多数是来自开普殖民地的英国人。

en.t: German geophysicist Alfred Wegener first presents his theory of continental drift
en.s: Alfred Lothar Wegener (; German: [ˈʔalfʁeːt ˈveːɡənɐ]; 1 November 1880 – November 1930) was a German climatologist, geologist, geophysicist, meteorologist, and polar researcher. During his lifetime he was primarily known for his achievements in meteorology and as a pioneer of polar research, but today he is most remembered as the originator of the continental drift hypothesis by suggesting in 1912 that the continents are slowly drifting around the Earth (German: Kontinentalverschiebung).

zh.t: 德国地球物理学家阿尔弗雷德·魏格纳首次提出大陆漂移学说
zh.s: 阿尔弗雷德·洛塔尔·魏格纳（1880年11月1日—1930年11月）是德国气候学家、地质学家、地球物理学家、气象学家及极地研究者。他生前主要以气象学成就和极地研究先驱的身份闻名，如今最为人熟知的则是大陆漂移假说的提出者：他于1912年提出，各大陆正在地球表面缓慢漂移（德语：Kontinentalverschiebung）。

en.s: The 1915 Argentine Primera División final was the match that determined the winner of 1915 season of Argentine Primera División. The final was contested by Racing and San Isidro, in order to decide a champion after both teams had finished tied on points (46 in 24 matches played) at the end of the tournament.

zh.s: 1915年阿根廷甲级联赛决赛用于决出该赛季冠军。联赛结束时，竞技队和圣伊西德罗队均在24场比赛中获得46分，因此两队通过这场决赛争夺冠军。

en.s: The 1917 Copa de Honor Municipalidad de Buenos Aires was the final that decided the champion of the 12th. edition of this National cup of Argentina. In the match, held in Estadio Crucecita (home of C.A. Independiente) in Avellaneda, Racing Club beat River Plate 3–1 in extra time, winning its four Copa de Honor trophy within five years.

zh.t: 1917年布宜诺斯艾利斯市荣誉杯决赛
zh.s: 1917年布宜诺斯艾利斯市荣誉杯决赛，决出了这项阿根廷全国杯赛第12届冠军。比赛在阿韦亚内达独立俱乐部的主场克鲁塞西塔球场举行，竞技俱乐部在加时赛中以3比1击败河床，五年内第四次夺得荣誉杯。

en.s: The Battle of Ławica was one of battles of the Greater Poland Uprising (1918–1919). It took place on January 6, 1919: Polish rebels defeated German forces, capturing the Poznań-Ławica Airport, together with rich war booty, estimated at 200 million ℳ. It is named after the now-suburb of Ławica.

zh.s: 瓦维察战役是1918年至1919年大波兰起义中的一场战斗，发生于1919年1月6日。波兰起义军击败德军，夺取波兹南—瓦维察机场，缴获了估值约2亿马克的大量战利品。战役以如今已成为波兹南郊区的瓦维察命名。

en.t: Roosevelt sets out the Four Freedoms
en.s: US president Franklin D. Roosevelt delivered his State of the Union address to Congress on January 6, setting out four freedoms he said people everywhere should enjoy: speech, worship, freedom from want and freedom from fear. The address came while World War II was under way but before the United States entered the conflict. Roosevelt argued that American security was linked to the survival of other democracies and described a role for the United States in assisting countries already at war. The speech became known as the Four Freedoms address and gave a concise expression to the administration's wartime aims.

zh.s: 1月6日，美国总统富兰克林·D.罗斯福向国会发表国情咨文，提出世界各地的人都应享有四大自由：言论自由、信仰自由、免于匮乏的自由，以及免于恐惧的自由。当时第二次世界大战已经爆发，美国尚未参战。罗斯福认为，美国的安全与其他民主国家的存亡息息相关，并说明美国应如何援助已处于战争中的国家。这篇演说后来被称为“四大自由”演说，简明表达了其政府的战时目标。

en.s: National Assembly elections were held in areas controlled by North Vietnam on 6 January 1946. Held under the 1946 constitution, they resulted in a victory for the Communist-led League for the Independence of Vietnam (better known as Viet Minh), which won 182 of the 302 seats, although the distribution of seats had been decided before the elections. The ballot was not secret, and ballot papers were filled in in the presence of aides who were "to help comrades who had difficulty in making out their ballots."

zh.s: 1946年1月6日，北越控制地区依据1946年宪法举行国民议会选举。共产党领导的越南独立同盟，通常称为越盟，赢得302席中的182席，不过席位分配在选举前就已决定。投票并不秘密，选票须在辅助人员在场时填写，这些人员被安排“帮助难以填写选票的同志”。

en.s: The Ganghwa massacre (Korean: 강화 양민학살 사건; Hanja: 江華良民虐殺事件) was a massacre conducted by the South Korean forces, South Korean Police forces and pro-South Korean militiamen, between 6 and 9 January 1951, of 212 to 1,300 unarmed civilians in the Ganghwa county of the Incheon metropolitan city in South Korea. The victims were so-called collaborators with the Korean People's Army during North Korean occupation.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1951年1月6日至9日，韩国军队、警察及亲韩民兵在江华郡屠杀了212至1,300名手无寸铁的平民；该郡属于韩国仁川广域市。受害者被称为朝鲜占领期间与朝鲜人民军合作的所谓“协力者”。

en.t: The Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization holds its first meeting
en.s: The International Maritime Organization (IMO) is a United Nations agency regulating maritime transport. Its founding convention was adopted at a conference in Geneva in 1948 and entered into force in 1958. The organization, initially called the Inter-Governmental Maritime Consultative Organization, first met on 6 January 1959.
en.n: This entry records the first meeting in 1959. The founding convention entered into force in 1958.

zh.t: 政府间海事协商组织召开首次会议
zh.s: 国际海事组织（IMO）是负责规范海上运输的联合国机构。其创始公约于1948年在日内瓦会议上通过，1958年生效。该组织最初名为政府间海事协商组织，于1959年1月6日首次开会。
zh.n: 此条记录的是1959年的首次会议。创始公约于1958年生效。

en.t: National Airlines Flight 2511 is destroyed in mid-air by a bomb, while en route from New York City to Miami
en.s: National Airlines Flight 2511 was a United States domestic passenger flight from New York City to Miami, Florida. On January 6, 1960, the Douglas DC-6 serving the flight exploded in midair. The National Airlines aircraft was carrying 5 crew members and 29 passengers, all of whom perished. The Civil Aeronautics Board investigation concluded that the plane was brought down by a bomb made of dynamite.

zh.t: 美国国家航空2511号班机从纽约飞往迈阿密途中遭炸弹破坏，在空中解体
zh.s: 美国国家航空2511号班机是从纽约市飞往佛罗里达州迈阿密的美国国内客运航班。1960年1月6日，执飞航班的道格拉斯DC-6飞机在空中爆炸，机上5名机组人员和29名乘客全部遇难。美国民用航空委员会调查认定，飞机被一枚以硝化甘油炸药制成的炸弹炸毁。

en.t: The Associations Law comes into force in Iraq, allowing registration of political parties
en.s: The Associations Law was a law in Iraq, which legally regulated political parties. The law was promulgated on 1 January 1960. Prior to the adoption of this law, political parties had been banned since 1954. The law came into force on 6 January 1960 (Army Day). Under this law, a party applying for legal status at the Ministry of Interior should have at least ten members (all Iraqi citizens) and at least 50 supporters.

zh.t: 伊拉克《社团法》生效，允许政党登记
zh.s: 《社团法》是伊拉克规范政党的法律，于1960年1月1日颁布。在该法通过之前，政党自1954年起一直被禁止活动。法律于1960年1月6日建军节生效。根据该法，向内政部申请合法地位的政党须有至少10名成员，且均为伊拉克公民，并拥有至少50名支持者。

en.s: Operation Deckhouse Five was a United States Marine Corps (USMC) and Republic of Vietnam Marine Corps operation that took place from 6–15 January 1967 in the Mekong Delta, during the Vietnam War. en.s: Nancy Ann Kerrigan (born October 13, 1969) is an American former figure skater. Kerrigan was inducted into the United States Figure Skating Hall of Fame in 2004.

zh.s: 南希·安·克里根（1969年10月13日出生）是美国前花样滑冰运动员。她曾获1991年世锦赛和1992年冬奥会铜牌、1992年世锦赛和1994年冬奥会银牌，以及1993年美国全国花样滑冰锦标赛冠军。2004年，克里根入选美国花样滑冰名人堂。

en.t: January 2015 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election
en.s: On January 6, 2015, the first day of the 114th United States Congress and two months after the 2014 U.S. House elections, the incoming House members held an election for its speaker. This was the 123rd speaker election since the office was created in 1789. The incumbent, John Boehner, received 216 votes, a majority of the votes cast and was re-elected to office, despite a coordinated effort by Freedom Caucus Republicans to oust him.
